newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran opens nitrobenzene plant in Sanandaj.
newsitem.headline: Iran opens nitrobenzene plant in Sanandaj.

text.p: Iran on Friday commissioned a nitrobenzene plant with a yearly capacity of 420 tonnes in its western city of Sanandaj, the Iranian news agecy IRNA said.
It quoted the plant's managing director Abbas Karimi as saying it would help Iran save as much as $750,000 on imports of nitrobenzene annually.
The agency said chemical compounds based in nitrobenzene are used in various industries including copper, sulphur mines, coal and textiles.
